tagline: Real-time visual observability layer for AI agents
description: A generic Denizen office template — sixteen AI teammates in a pixel-art workspace. Customize company name, souls, and business model when you clone a template pack to your org.

sprint.name: Getting started — Denizen office
sprint.goal: Learn the team, explore chat and delegation, customize your company context.

current_focus: Meet the 16-agent roster and learn each role
Try player chat and in-office delegation
Customize souls and business model for your company (team tier)

Triage demo-tier questions — no binding commitments
